An age where a great number of people are chasing their wild dreams within the great skyscraper at humanity's frontier. A ludicrous amount of capital. The boy named Hal was facing a place that gathered up people's desires. Sometimes it granted them, and sometimes it crushed them mercilessly. When the direction was decided, she sets out for her trip--a trip without any plans.
